rules.current_implementation: ZoneInfo resolves named-zone historical offsets, DST ambiguity and nonexistent local times before any solar correction.
rules.dispute_summary: Pre-1970 tzdb coverage is uneven and is not jurisdictional legal proof.
rules.impact_if_changed: May change normalized instant and every downstream pillar candidate.
rules.replay_compatibility: Requires a new calendar version; old version must remain replayable.
rules.copyright_or_license_note: tzdb data and notices are governed separately from project code.
rules.reviewer_note: Technical time normalization only; it does not select a metaphysical chart.

rules.current_implementation: Preserves civil time and derives local mean and apparent solar-time candidates from longitude and equation of time.
rules.dispute_summary: Astronomical correction is well-defined; whether BaZi should use it as chart time is method-specific.
rules.replay_compatibility: Profile and calendar version are required in replay manifest.
rules.copyright_or_license_note: Formula is summarized; no protected prose is redistributed.
rules.reviewer_note: D-001 product flow is frozen; main-chart selection is not.

rules.current_implementation: Switches sexagenary year at the astronomical instant of Lichun.
rules.dispute_summary: HKO supports the astronomical instant, not the BaZi method choice.
rules.replay_compatibility: Old method profile must remain addressable.
rules.copyright_or_license_note: Official astronomical pages are cited by link.
rules.reviewer_note: Requires qualified traditional review and signed boundary cases.

rules.current_implementation: Uses twelve astronomical jie instants as start-inclusive month boundaries.
rules.dispute_summary: Exact inclusion and traditional month-switch policy require method review.
rules.impact_if_changed: Changes month pillar at 24 annual boundaries.
rules.copyright_or_license_note: Official astronomical pages are cited by link.
rules.reviewer_note: All twelve boundaries are tested, but not yet authoritative traditional goldens.

rules.current_implementation: Computes a proleptic-Gregorian JDN and applies a versioned sexagenary-day epoch asset.
rules.dispute_summary: The epoch lacks an independent authoritative source package and broad historical goldens.
rules.impact_if_changed: Changes day and hour stem across all dates.
rules.replay_compatibility: Must version a replacement; never overwrite the epoch asset.
rules.copyright_or_license_note: Internal data asset; source provenance remains incomplete.

rules.current_implementation: Profiles expose midnight rollover, Zi-initial 23:00 rollover, and split early/late Zi candidates.
rules.dispute_summary: D-002 remains unfrozen; no profile may be silently selected.
rules.impact_if_changed: Changes day pillar and hour stem around Zi hour.
rules.reviewer_note: Owner and qualified reviewer decision required.

rules.current_implementation: Emits four stems/branches plus their indexed yin-yang and five-element reference data.
rules.dispute_summary: Table structure is mechanical; interpretive meaning is outside this rule.
rules.copyright_or_license_note: Short factual tables; provenance should still be strengthened.
rules.reviewer_note: Does not constitute strength, pattern or useful-god analysis.

rules.current_implementation: Ten Gods, hidden stems, relations, Na Yin, strength, pattern, climate adjustment and useful-god conclusions are not emitted by the engine.
rules.dispute_summary: These domains require separate source and school decisions.
rules.impact_if_changed: Would add new business conclusions and is outside Sprint 20A.
rules.replay_compatibility: Future implementation requires a new ruleset family.
rules.reviewer_note: Five-element counting must not be described as strength analysis.

rules.current_implementation: Luck direction, start age, decade cycles, annual and monthly luck are not produced.
rules.dispute_summary: Attested rules do not establish a unique modern production profile.
rules.copyright_or_license_note: Public-domain text may be cited; edition and transcription must be reviewed.

rules.current_implementation: Requires a manually verified lunar date; automatic Gregorian-to-lunar conversion is absent.
rules.dispute_summary: Input contract is explicit; conversion method is not implemented.
rules.impact_if_changed: Automatic conversion may alter every downstream palace/star result.
rules.replay_compatibility: Manual lunar input and profile are snapshot fields.
rules.reviewer_note: UI must not imply automatic conversion.

rules.current_implementation: Exposes same-month and day-16-next-month leap-month policies as separate profiles.
rules.dispute_summary: No traditional source or qualified lineage review is registered.
rules.impact_if_changed: Can change life/body palaces and all star placement.

rules.current_implementation: Calculates life/body palaces, twelve palace ordering and palace stems.
rules.dispute_summary: Code is deterministic but source registry has null traditional source.
rules.copyright_or_license_note: Embedded factual tables need source provenance review.

rules.current_implementation: Derives five-element bureau from life-palace stem/branch through an embedded Na Yin lookup.
rules.dispute_summary: Traditional source is null.
rules.impact_if_changed: Changes Ziwei placement and decade start.

rules.current_implementation: Places fourteen major stars using embedded deterministic offsets.
rules.dispute_summary: Source and lineage review are required; tests prove stability, not authority.
rules.replay_compatibility: Old offset table must remain available.

rules.current_implementation: Loads a birth-year transformation candidate table and returns structural transformation labels only.
rules.dispute_summary: Four-transformation tables differ by school and no source is registered.

rules.current_implementation: Starts decades at bureau number, uses yang-male/yin-female forward direction, and emits a simple annual branch.
rules.dispute_summary: Direction, start and flowing methods require school Profile and source review.
rules.replay_compatibility: Future corrections require a new version.

rules.current_implementation: Auxiliary/malefic stars, palace-stem flying transformations, complete Sanfang Sizheng reasoning, Mingzhu/Shenzhu, brightness and full flowing interpretation are absent.
rules.dispute_summary: Multiple schools must not be blended implicitly.
rules.reviewer_note: Current data structure is not a complete school system.

rules.current_implementation: Accepts six bottom-to-top tosses, each containing three integer coin values of 2 or 3; sums map to 6/7/8/9.
rules.dispute_summary: The 2/3 face convention is explicit but lacks a formal traditional source record.
rules.replay_compatibility: Method ID and raw tosses are preserved.
rules.reviewer_note: Source gap must be closed before calling the convention traditionally approved.

rules.current_implementation: Maps 6/8 to yin, 7/9 to yang, marks 6/9 moving, and flips moving lines for the transformed hexagram.
rules.dispute_summary: Mechanics are explicit; traditional documentation remains incomplete.

rules.current_implementation: Builds lower trigram from lines 1-3, upper trigram from 4-6, and resolves received King Wen number/name from a 64-entry asset.
rules.method_or_school: received King Wen order and names
rules.dispute_summary: Sequence/name lookup does not select a divination interpretation method.
rules.copyright_or_license_note: Unicode names list and public received-text references are linked, not copied extensively.

rules.current_implementation: Reports moving-line positions but has no zero/one/multiple-moving-line judgement strategy; hexagram and line texts are not used for conclusions.
rules.dispute_summary: Interpretive strategies differ and require explicit Profile selection.
rules.copyright_or_license_note: No hexagram or line-text corpus ingested.

rules.current_implementation: Na Jia, Shi/Ying, Six Relations, Six Spirits, month/day, void, useful spirit, strength, advancing/retreating spirits and complete Liuyao judgement are absent.
rules.dispute_summary: Three-coin casting is not a complete Liuyao Najia system.
rules.impact_if_changed: Would introduce a new traditional subsystem.

rules.current_implementation: Downstream Sanji mappings remain separately versioned and must not be described as traditional BaZi mechanics.
rules.dispute_summary: Not a traditional claim.
rules.copyright_or_license_note: Rule-data rights are separate from code licensing.
rules.reviewer_note: Included only to enforce layer separation.
